shipping.standard_shipping: Standard shipping typically takes 3-5 business days.
shipping.express_shipping: Express shipping typically takes 1-2 business days.

returns.return_window: Eligible products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
returns.return_condition: Products must be unused and returned in their original packaging.

refunds.processing_time: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after an eligible return is approved.

order_tracking.requirement: Customers must provide an order number to request order tracking.
order_tracking.limitation: The customer support agent cannot access real-time order information.

escalation.security: Suspected fraud or unauthorized account access must be escalated to a human representative.
escalation.unresolved_issues: Requests that cannot be resolved by the agent should be escalated to a human representative.
